{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ruling Synod''' was the governement of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A traitor in their midst made it possible for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to slay the entire Sydoch during a [[Battle of Bakura (Clone Wars)|battle]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
